name: Molnar Roofing Inc.
website: none working - molnarroofinginc.com (the address on their Google profile) redirects to a parked/blocked third-party page
what_they_do: Small roofing contractor doing roof replacement and repair with a noted specialty in slate roofs and a maintenance plan, plus gutter work. Reviews describe the owner (Steve) personally handling the job from estimate through cleanup.
customers: Homeowners in North Brunswick and surrounding Middlesex County

size_signals.signal: Google profile shows one North Brunswick address (513 3rd Ave), no secondary locations
Only 5 reviews across three years on the aggregator (2017 and 2019 reviews are the most recent shown)
Birdeye profile is unclaimed by the business

listing.reviews: small count; 5 reviews shown on Birdeye/BestProsInTown

website_review.out_of_date_signs: molnarroofinginc.com resolves to a third-party 'Access Denied' page - the domain appears lapsed or parked, yet Google still lists it as the website
website_review.search_basics: No site, so no titles, service pages or schema; only directory listings (YellowPages, Birdeye, BestProsInTown) describe the business
top_issues: Dead website linked from their own Google profile - a customer who clicks it lands on an error page
Google profile has no hours and invites 'Add missing information'
No way to request a quote online at all

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: a Google profile exists with the right name, address, phone and 'Roofing contractor' category but no hours and a broken website link; Birdeye profile unclaimed. Answerable: nothing a crawler can read - no site, no schema, no service list, no service area, no prices; the only text about them is on directories. Bookable: phone only.

operations_signals.signal: All intake is by phone to the owner; no form, email or booking channel is published anywhere I could find
Review flow has dried up - most recent visible review is from 2019, suggesting no systematic review requests

top_opportunities.opportunity: Get a live one-page site back on the domain plus a complete Google profile (hours, services, photos, service area)
top_opportunities.evidence: Google profile links molnarroofinginc.com, which now returns an Access Denied/parked page; profile has no hours

top_opportunities.opportunity: Simple quote-request form and missed-call text-back so jobs do not depend on one person answering the phone
top_opportunities.evidence: Only published contact channel is a single phone line to the owner

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated review requests after each job
top_opportunities.evidence: Public review record is sparse and years old despite an otherwise clean 5.0 rating

scores.reasons: Gap is large: no working site, no hours, no text, no booking. Ability to pay looks limited - very small operation with a thin review footprint and no visible commercial work. Ease is the best in the batch because a landing page plus profile cleanup is a fast win. Evidence is moderate: I confirmed the dead domain, the profile and the directory reviews, but there is little public detail about the business.
